# HERPES KERATITIS

Ocular herpes infection can be caused by either HSV-1 or HSV-2. The majority of cases are caused by HSV-1. The recurrence rate of ocular herpes is 40% over a 5 year period, less than that of oral or genital herpes. Ocular herpes is a major cause of blindness and typically presents as infection of the epithelium of the cornea but can also rarely involve the stroma and endothelium.
Ophthalmology consultation is recommended.
Involvement of the stroma or endothelium requires treatment with topical steroid and close monitoring. For these cases, start oral antiviral and consult ophthalmology for management.
Antiviral prophylaxis is recommended for patients with multiple recurrences, recurrent episodes with ulceration, recurrent inflammation with scar/vascularization approaching visual axis, patients who have had keratoplasty for HSV-related scarring/astigmatism, and patients who have had HSV keratitis while on immunosuppressive therapy. Post-surgical prophylaxis is not discussed here. Please consult ophthalmology for more information.

Therapy:
## Treatment of acute infection

Without epithelial ulceration

## Inpatient

Acyclovir 400 mg PO q8h for 7-10 days ($) [R]
<OR>
Valacyclovir 500 mg PO q12h for 7-10 days ($) [R]
Ulceration of epithelium (Geographic ulcer)
Acyclovir 800 mg PO 5x/day for 14-21 days ($) [R]
<OR>
Valacyclovir 1 gm PO q8h for 14-21 days ($) [R]

### Infection prophylaxis for prevention of recurrence

Reassess need for prophylaxis every 12 months
Acyclovir 400 mg PO Q12h for 12 months ($) [R]
<OR>
Valacyclovir 500 mg PO Q24h for 12 months ($) [R]

## Outpatient

Acyclovir 400 mg PO TID for 7-10 days ($) [R]
<OR>
Valacyclovir 500 mg PO BID for 7-10 days ($) [R]
Ulceration of epithelium (Geographic ulcer)
Acyclovir 800 mg PO 5x/day for 14-21 days ($) [R]
<OR>
Valacyclovir 1 gm PO TID for 14-21 days ($) [R]

### Infection prophylaxis for prevention of recurrence

Reassess need for prophylaxis every 12 months
Acyclovir 400 mg PO BID for 12 months ($) [R]
<OR>
Valacyclovir 500 mg PO QDay for 12 months ($) [R]
